What is the difference between a temporary setting and a permanent setting in Vim?
fields.Back: A temporary setting (e.g., :set number) is lost when Vim closes. A permanent setting is written to vimrc and persists across sessions.

Why can ML models not answer causal questions?
fields.Back: ML is about prediction and correlation, not causal structure. It cannot handle inverse causality, like low prices being associated with low hotel sales during off-season.
